## Current consolidated truth
The Larkspur ferry inspection is on May 21. Tobiah Quell moved it there from May 14, and Wenna Ostrow confirmed the new date with the harbour office, so the office and the crew work from the same day. Wenna Ostrow also signs off any spending of the inspection crew, which makes her the one person to ask about the inspection, its date and what the crew may buy for it.

The thread is short and settled. The date is the only value that changed, and the earlier date is history: anyone planning around the inspection should use the live date above. The ferry will be out of service for the day of the inspection, and passengers need a notice about it a week ahead, which the thread names as an open item rather than a decision.
